200.title: Polish government sets out draft 2027 budget with deficit remaining at 7.1% of GDP
200.summary: Polish government sets out draft 2027 budget with deficit remaining at 7.1% of GDP Aug 28, 2026 | Business , Energy & Climate , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! Revenues are projected to rise by 68.4 billion zloty to 695 billion zloty, leaving a nominal budget deficit of 282.6 billion zloty, the highest on record and 10 billion zloty more than this year.
200.body: Polish government sets out draft 2027 budget with deficit remaining at 7.1% of GDP Aug 28, 2026 | Business , Energy & Climate , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The deficit is forecast at 7.1% of GDP, unchanged from 2026 but well above the level of 3.7% the government had committed to reach by 2027 after Poland was placed under the European Union’s excessive deficit procedure in 2024. Revenues are projected to rise by 68.4 billion zloty to 695 billion zloty, leaving a nominal budget deficit of 282.6 billion zloty, the highest on record and 10 billion zloty more than this year. Poland’s gross borrowing needs are projected at 565 billion zloty in 2027, below the 688 billion zloty budgeted for this year.

500.title: Google’s Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash brings controllable AI video to developers
500.summary: The broader Gemini Omni model family, which Google introduced earlier, is built to combine images, audio, video and text as input and generate video grounded in what Google calls its “real-world knowledge.” That means the model draws on an understanding of physics, including forces like gravity, kinetic energy and fluid dynamics, to make generated scenes look more plausible.
500.body: Google is packaging scene continuation, camera control, cheap previews and high-resolution finishing into one workflow, available now through Google AI Studio, Google Flow and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. The broader Gemini Omni model family, which Google introduced earlier, is built to combine images, audio, video and text as input and generate video grounded in what Google calls its “real-world knowledge.” That means the model draws on an understanding of physics, including forces like gravity, kinetic energy and fluid dynamics, to make generated scenes look more plausible. Google also identifies Adobe, Figma Weave, GMI Cloud and Runway as companies already using or integrating Gemini Omni Flash in creative workflows, a sign that the tools are moving beyond Google’s own platforms. The AI video evaluation platform Arena reported that Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash ranked first in the Text-to-Video Arena and second in the Image-to-Video Arena.

600.body: Sunday brings us six games in Groups K and L, the biggest one being the matchup between the defending world champions Germany, and one of a 7-0 surprise package of the Qualifiers in Poland. Poland have won 10 of their 12 home games in the World Cup Qualifiers, including the most recent five, but their last home defat was against Germany, 69-72 in November 2021. Dennis Schroder (Germany) has had 20+ points and 5+ assists in each of his last three games in the World Cup Qualifiers, while only Luka Doncic (4) has recorded a longer such run in Europe in the competition. Hungary have won their last two games in the World Cup Qualifiers, but they have never won three in a row during a single campaign of qualifiers.
